result.topic_en: Expansions of integrals of the form ∫_0^∞ dx/[x(e^{2πx}−1)(e^{2πa/x}−1)] and ∫_0^∞ dx/[(e^{2πx}−1)(e^{2πa/x}−1)] as divisor-function series in Bessel-type integrals ψ(na), χ(na), and their transformation into other series, plus a similar formula for a series in σ_{-1/2}(n) e^{-2π√(na)}.
result.transcription:
Add Ms a 94^{18(A)} (4)

If $\int_0^\infty \frac{1}{x} e^{-2\pi(x+\frac{a}{x})}dx = \psi(a)$
then $\int_0^\infty \frac{dx}{x(e^{2\pi x}-1)(e^{\frac{2\pi a}{x}}-1)}$

$= d(1)\psi(a) + d(2)\psi(2a) + d(3)\psi(3a) + \cdots$

$= \frac{a}{\pi^2}\left\{\frac{d(1)\log\frac{a}{1}}{a^2-1^2} + \frac{d(2)\log\frac{a}{2}}{a^2-2^2} + \frac{d(3)\log\frac{a}{3}}{a^2-3^2} + \cdots\right\}$
$-\frac{1}{2}\gamma - \log a\left(\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{4\pi^2 a}\right) - \frac{\log 2\pi}{2\pi^2 a}$.

$\sigma_{-\frac{1}{2}}(1)e^{-2\pi\sqrt{a}} + \sigma_{-\frac{1}{2}}(2)e^{-2\pi\sqrt{2a}} + \sigma_{-\frac{1}{2}}(3)e^{-2\pi\sqrt{3a}} + \cdots$

$= Ka\left\{\frac{\sigma_{-\frac{1}{2}}(1)}{(1+a)(\sqrt{1}+\sqrt{a})} + \frac{\sigma_{-\frac{1}{2}}(2)}{(2+a)(\sqrt{2}+\sqrt{a})} + \frac{\sigma_{-\frac{1}{2}}(3)}{(3+a)(\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{a})} + \cdots\right\}$
+ two trivial terms.

If $\int_0^\infty e^{-2\pi(x+\frac{a}{x})}dx = \chi(a)$
then $\int_0^\infty \frac{dx}{(e^{2\pi x}-1)(e^{\frac{2\pi a}{x}}-1)}$
$= \sigma_{-1}(1)\chi(a) + \sigma_{-1}(2)\chi(2a) + \sigma_{-1}(3)\chi(3a) + \cdot$
$= Ka^2\left\{\frac{\sigma_{-1}(1)}{1(1+a)} + \frac{\sigma_{-1}(2)}{2(2+a)} + \frac{\sigma_{-1}(3)}{3(3+a)} + \cdots\right\}$ + two trivial terms.

methods.what: Definition of ψ(a) as an integral of Bessel K_0 type
Expansion of the double-Bose integral with 1/x weight as a divisor-function series in ψ(na)
Transformation of that integral into a series in d(n) log(a/n)/(a^2-n^2) plus elementary terms
Transformation of the series Σ σ_{-1/2}(n) e^{-2π√(na)} into a rational-type series
Definition of χ(a) as an integral of Bessel K_1 type
Expansion of ∫ dx/((e^{2πx}-1)(e^{2πa/x}-1)) as Σ σ_{-1}(n) χ(na) and transformation into a series Σ σ_{-1}(n)/(n(n+a))

items.english: The series Σ σ_{-1/2}(n)e^{-2π√(na)} equals Ka times the series Σ σ_{-1/2}(n)/((n+a)(√n+√a)) plus two trivial terms.
The integral equals Ka² times the series Σ σ_{-1}(n)/(n(n+a)) plus two trivial terms.
The integral with 1/x weight equals a/π² times Σ d(n) log(a/n)/(a²−n²), minus γ/2, minus log a·(1/4 + 1/(4π²a)), minus log 2π/(2π²a).
